note: MAN-INV-72 v7.2.2 is the superseded Ledgerline ERP 7.2 User Manual for Inventory, dated 2024-06-10. It covers inventory screens, services, parameters, and error messages for stock transfers, adjustments, counts, and returns. As of 2026-10-26, this manual version has been superseded by newer releases. Part 2 of MAN-INV-72 v7.2.2 is an extract of the superseded Ledgerline ERP 7.2 Inventory manual dated 10 June 2024. It documents screens INV-MRN-08, INV-BIN-09, INV-LOT-10, INV-QCH-11, and INV-RES-12, covering material issues, bin definitions, lot and serial tracking, quality hold, and stock reservations. Today (26 October 2026), this manual version is superseded. Old superseded Ledgerline ERP 7.2.2 Inventory manual (MAN-INV-72 v7.2.2) dated 10 June 2024. Part 3 covers screen specifications, fields, services, and error handling for screens INV-RES-12, INV-WHS-01, INV-ITM-01, INV-STK-03, and INV-KBN-13 across the Manchester plant and Leeds unit. This version is superseded by subsequent Ledgerline ERP 7.2 documentation. Old user manual MAN-INV-72 (v7.2.2) covering Ledgerline ERP 7.2 inventory screens INV-CCP-14, INV-PKG-15, INV-SCR-16, and INV-CSG-17, along with an inventory error and warning message catalogue. The document is dated 2024-06-10 and is marked superseded. It provides historical guidance on cycle counting, returnable packaging, scrap notes, and consignment inventory operations.

In the v7.2.2 text for INV-RES-12, the 'Messages' section defines ERR-RES-0201 as 'Insufficient free physical stock', but the subsequent 'Questions users ask' section states that ERR-RES-0201 indicates 'the reservation is already closed or cancelled'.

In the v7.2.2 text for INV-ITM-01, the 'Messages' section states ERR-ITM-0001 is duplicate code and ERR-ITM-0011 is missing mandatory entries, but 'Questions users ask' reverses them, claiming ERR-ITM-0001 is blank mandatory fields and ERR-ITM-0011 is an existing code.
This source is MAN-INV-72 v7.2.2 dated 2024-06-10 and marked SUPERSEDED; later v7.2 revisions or patches supersede this manual.
On INV-SCR-16, the main messages section states ERR-SCR-0201 is 'Stock levels are insufficient', whereas the questions section states it appears when status is already posted.

In the messages catalog (p. 29), ERR-CSG-0201 is defined as 'QTY MUST BE > 0', whereas in section 19 it is described as 'settlement quantity exceeds the available consignment balance' or a line that already has closed status.
